Speaker: IMC_STUDENT

context:
File: TALK/M035_TALK.NUT

Line: 211

context:

Speaker: IMC_STUDENT

Line: 250
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT

Line: 251

Voice:

context:
File: TALK/M035_TALK.NUT
Line: 252
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

context:

Line: 253
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT

context:

Line: 255
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

File: TALK/M035_TALK.NUT
Line: 256
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

最近日子越来越难过了
context:
File: TALK/M035_TALK.NUT
Line: 257
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

context:
File: TALK/M035_TALK.NUT
Line: 258
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

original: 貴方だけは生き残ってね\n約束よ？
translation: 只有你一定要活下去\n约定好了？
context:
File: TALK/M035_TALK.NUT
Line: 259
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

original: あー　せめて恋して死にたかったなー
translation: 啊～至少想谈场恋爱再死啊～
context:
File: TALK/M035_TALK.NUT
Line: 260
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

context:
File: TALK/M035_TALK.NUT
Line: 261
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

translation: 虽然要疏散，但挺好的\n这里本来就是个讨厌的地方
context:
File: TALK/M035_TALK.NUT
Line: 262
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

original: あんたが！　あんたが私の家族をころしたんだ！\n同級生を殺したんだ！　あんたが…
translation: 就是你！是你杀了我的家人！\n还杀了我的同学！就是你……
context:

Line: 263
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

Line: 264
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT

Speaker: IMC_STUDENT

File: TALK/M035_TALK.NUT
Line: 266
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

context:
File: TALK/M035_TALK.NUT
Line: 267
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

original: %sには、\n関わらない方がいいって、ホント
translation: 真的，最好别和%s扯上关系
context:
File: TALK/M035_TALK.NUT
Line: 268
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

original: ケガがないよう、お祈りしてるから…
translation: 我会祈祷你平安无事的……
context:
File: TALK/M035_TALK.NUT
Line: 269
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

original: 早く追っ払っちゃって
context:
File: TALK/M035_TALK.NUT
Line: 270
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

original: 助けて！　お家に帰りたい
context:
File: TALK/M035_TALK.NUT
Line: 271
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

original: シェルターなんてこりごりなのに
translation: 避难所什么的真是受够了
context:
File: TALK/M035_TALK.NUT
Line: 272
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

File: TALK/M035_TALK.NUT
Line: 273
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

context:
File: TALK/M035_TALK.NUT
Line: 274
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

original: 眠ってるときにシェルターに避難とか言われると、\n困るよね…
translation: 睡得正香时被叫去避难所……\n真是够呛啊……
context:
File: TALK/M035_TALK.NUT
Line: 275
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

original: 閉所恐怖症だからシェルターって苦手なんだ
translation: 我有幽闭恐惧症，避难所实在待不惯
context:
File: TALK/M035_TALK.NUT
Line: 276
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

original: 今日も天気いいね？\nふふっ
translation: 今天天气也很好呢？\n呵呵～
context:
File: TALK/M035_TALK.NUT
Line: 277
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

original: 数学って苦手なんだよね
context:
File: TALK/M035_TALK.NUT
Line: 278
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

original: ネルフで仕事するとお金もらえるの？
context:
File: TALK/M035_TALK.NUT
Line: 279
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

original: 友達付き合いも大変だよ？
context:
File: TALK/M035_TALK.NUT
Line: 280
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

translation: 甜食是装在另一个胃里的呢♪
context:
File: TALK/M035_TALK.NUT
Line: 281
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

original: 昨日、おとうさんが風呂上り裸で歩いててー
translation: 昨天老爸洗完澡光着身子到处走——
context:
File: TALK/M035_TALK.NUT
Line: 282
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

original: 君もスポーツで\nいい汗かいてみたら？
translation: 你也该运动运动出点汗啦？
context:
File: TALK/M035_TALK.NUT
Line: 283
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

original: たまには学校サボってみちゃう？\nなあんてね
translation: 偶尔也会想逃课呢\n开玩笑的啦
context:

Line: 284
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
